exposure: Early postoperative oral fluid intake (within 6-8 hours after surgery)
Delayed/conventional oral fluid intake (16-24 hours after surgery)
outcome: Time to return of bowel sound
cohort: 100 term pregnant women who underwent an uncomplicated caesarean section under regional anaesthesia.
finding: Early feeding after an uncomplicated caesarean section significantly reduced the duration of intravenous fluid administration, time to flatus passage, rate of ileus symptoms, time to return of bowel sound and stools, and hospital stay, leading to higher maternal satisfaction.
